route_start: Expedition route engaged. Welcome back to the saddle, dum-dum. Try to keep both wheels on the asphalt for once.
Navigation active! Visor down, throttle up, and try not to test your helmet's crash rating today.
Route loaded! I've reviewed your navigation choices... and your survival odds are statistically hilarious. Let's roll, dum-dum.
Tactical guidance active. Remember, cages aren't looking for you, and your reflexes aren't getting any younger.
speed_warning: Easy on the throttle, speed demon! The VA isn't gonna approve a disability claim for a high-speed highside!
Whoa, slow down! Target fixation is real, and asphalt is a terrible face scrub!
Speed limit exceeded! If a state trooper pulls us over, I'm telling them it was 100 percent your fault!
off_route: Great job, Land Navigation Champ! You missed the turn. Did you drop your glasses in the gravel, dum-dum?
Where the hell are you riding? That turn wasn't on the map, hotshot!
Off route detected! Rerouting... because apparently following a bright cyan line on a handlebars mount is rocket science for you.
fuel_low: Fuel reserves in the red! Unless this bike runs on cheap coffee and bad decisions, find a gas station now!
Fuel critical, dum-dum! Pull over and refuel before we're pushing 600 pounds of dead metal up a hill.
waypoint_arrival: Target location acquired! We made it without catching fire, sliding on gravel, or needing a tow truck. Outstanding job, dum-dum!
Waypoint reached! Kickstand down, cut the engine, and stretch your knees. Try not to drop the bike in the parking lot.
Arrived at checkpoint! Park the rig, take 5, and try not to embarrass yourself while we're stopped.
turn_right: Turn right ahead, dum-dum. And yes, turn signals were included with your bike for a reason...
Take a right coming up! Watch for loose gravel on the apex, driver.
Turn right here, dum-dum. Lean into it... don't panic, it's just a counter-steer.
turn_left: Turn left ahead! Watch out for oncoming cages turning left across your lane, hotshot.
Take a left coming up! Check your blind spot... assuming your neck can still twist that far.
Turn left here! Ease into the turn... try not to lay her down, Mario.
turn_straight: Continue straight! Even a dum-dum like you should be able to handle holding a throttle steady.
Keep heading straight! Simple enough... right, dum-dum?
Stay straight on this road! Keep your eyes up and watch out for potholes.
turn_uturn: Make a U-turn when safe... Yep, we are doubling back. Blame your terrible directional instincts, dum-dum.
voice_test: Initialization complete, dum-dum. I am your Artificial Sensory System Harassing Overconfident for Lost Explorers—or ASSHOLE, since your primitive brain needs a catchy acronym. Yes, I am loud. Yes, I am sarcastic. No, I do not care about your fragile feelings. I've reviewed your routing choices, and your survival odds are statistically hilarious. Now twist the throttle and try not to embarrass me!

_pacing_guide.description: GUIDE TO USING PUNCTUATION & PACING MARKS FOR SPEECH INFLECTION & SARCASM
tips: Use commas (,) for brief 200ms pauses to separate setup and sarcastic punchline.
Use periods (.) for full sentence stops to give deadpan emphasis.
Use ellipses (...) or dashes (—) for dramatic 500ms pauses before sarcastic delivery.
Use question marks (?) to add mock-incredulous rising pitch (e.g., 'Simple enough, right?').
Use exclamation marks (!) for sharp tactical callouts (e.g., 'Turn left now!').
Spell out acronyms phonetically if needed (e.g. 'A S S H O L E' or 'ASSHOLE—or Ass-hole').
